name: @restregular/dsh-notepad
description: Notepad — a per-workspace floating notepad in the DeepSeek Harness session view: oldest-first segment cards with click-to-edit titles, Enter split after the source, Backspace merge into the previous card, drag to reorder, merge selected segments, arrow-key navigation, AI improve with undo and cached results, delayed hover groups for insert / send / archive-delete (including fresh-session variants), in-panel image previews, empty-segment deletion without a prompt, rotating shortcut tips, copy-all that skips archived segments, the General Settings busy-send policy, image chips with automatic file cleanup, pending-count badges on the hidden button and sidebar workspace, scroll-safe auto refresh, a textarea that only scrolls at its height limit, resizable title-bar-safe panel, Ctrl+Shift+R geometry reset, and dark-mode styling. · 记事本 — 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话界面显示一个按工作区共享的分段便签浮窗：分段按从旧到新、从上到下排列，回车拆分后新卡片紧跟原卡片，在段首按 Backspace 会与上一段合并；空标题只在点击后显示输入框；可拖拽排序、合并选中分段、上下方向键切换分段、只对选中分段做 AI 优化并可撤销 / 复用缓存；插入、发送、归档+删除按钮 hover 稍候才展开为细边框按钮组（插入/发送含新会话变体）；图片支持面板内预览；空分段删除无需确认，空段内按 Backspace 自动删除；底部快捷键提示点击轮换；复制全部排除归档；发送跟随「设置 > 通用设置」的繁忙发送策略；图片芯片删除时自动清理磁盘文件；隐藏按钮与侧边栏工作区显示未发送数量角标；自动刷新保持滚动位置；分段文本到最大高度才出现滚动条；可调整尺寸，Ctrl+Shift+R 复位位置和尺寸，浮窗不会越过窗口标题栏，并适配深色模式。
author: RestRegular
